outcome: Insulin receptor substrate (IRS)-2 expression in VAT
Ser312 phosphorylation of IRS-1 in VAT
cohort: Fifty-six nulliparous pregnant women were recruited, including normal glucose tolerant (n = 30) and GDM (n = 26) participants, subgrouped by nonobese or obese BMI.
finding: GDM-obese pregnancy is specifically characterized by inadequate visceral adipose tissue (VAT) remodeling and dysfunctional molecular signaling, contributing to insulin resistance and hindering metabolic health.
